top_signals.title: Natixis Economist Sees One More Fed Rate Hike
top_signals.summary: Christopher Hodge, chief US economist at Natixis, expects core CPI to come in slightly softer than forecast and sees inflation continuing to ease. He discusses the impact of higher energy prices, potential labor market weakness and housing pressures, while forecasting one final Fed rate hike in December before the tightening cycle ends. He spoke on Bloomberg Brief. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Zloty Is Still ‘Strong’ After Slide, Polish MPC’s Litwiniuk Says
top_signals.summary: Poland’s currency remains at a “strong” level even after weakening in recent months and isn’t a particular point of focus for the central bank, according to policymaker Przemyslaw Litwiniuk.
